{"id":"mimid-krmn","title":"Align component negotiation with mls-extensions #110","description":"mlswg/mls-extensions PR #110 (merged 2026-11-01, closes #102) adds §5 negotiation rules modeled on required_capabilities (RFC 9420 §11.1). Bring mimid in line:

1. Built-ins not listed: support for app_components (0x0001) and safe_aad (0x0002) is implied by app_data_dictionary support; they are not listed, and an entry for either is ignored. mimid currently lists 0x0001 in its LeafNode app_components (decision mimid-1wgh.4.25 reading B, 7ea4456). Stop sending it; ignore it on receipt. Supersede that decision.
2. Absent app_components or safe_aad in a LeafNode = empty list. A LeafNode that does not list a component is treated as not supporting it.
3. Leaf validation (part of RFC 9420 §7.3, wherever a LeafNode is validated): a LeafNode in a group is invalid if the GroupContext app_components or safe_aad lists a component the LeafNode's corresponding list does not. Checked against the GroupContext of the validating epoch; proposal and UpdatePath LeafNodes are checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext. Does not apply to KeyPackage LeafNodes before Add (rule 5 catches those).
4. Join: a client MUST NOT join a group whose GroupContext requires a component it does not support.
5. Commit: invalid if the resulting epoch's GroupContext requires a component that a member of the resulting epoch does not list in its LeafNode.
6. State tied to list: a GroupContext is invalid if app_data_dictionary has an entry for a component (other than 0x0001/0x0002) not listed in app_components. Apply at group creation, to the resulting epoch of each Commit, and to the GroupContext a joiner receives. Judge by resulting epoch, so one Commit may require a component and set its state in any proposal order.
7. content_media_types: when a group creator includes it in the GroupContext, the GroupContext must also list it in app_components.

Already matching: Safe AAD components listed in both app_components and safe_aad. Clients need not advertise every implemented component (kkohbrok on #102).

First audit which of 3-6 mimid already enforces; unverified. Tests need an independent oracle (spec-derived vectors or cross-check against another implementation), not mimid's own output.

{"design":"PLAN (2026-11-02, awaiting Mark). Target: mls-extensions editor's copy after PR #110 (merge 500622f7), per Mark; audit in notes. Decompose into 5 sub-beads, landed in order, each regression-test-first with an independent peer (mls-rs leaves/groups with crafted app_data_dictionary, or hand-encoded ComponentsLists):
K1 (rule 1): leaves stop listing app_components 0x0001 and safe_aad 0x0002 (identity.rs:286-287); receivers ignore 0x0001/0x0002 in GroupContext and leaf lists (required_lists / first_unsupported). Supersede decisions .4.25/.4.63. Update key_package_mls_rs.rs byte fixture per the new rule.
K2 (rule 4): join_welcome checks this identity's own leaf against the GroupContext lists and refuses before into_group (create and external join already do).
K3 (rule 5): a Commit is invalid if the resulting GroupContext requires a component that ANY member of the resulting epoch does not list (today only added/updated leaves are checked); applies to Member commit/process, Observer process, hence the hub.
K4 (rule 3): proposal and UpdatePath LeafNodes are checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext (supersede .4.49 post-Commit for these; K3 keeps the post-Commit all-members check); standalone Add/Update proposals are checked on receipt (Member::process, Observer add_proposal/process_proposal); existing tree leaves that fail are REFUSED at join_welcome / join_external / Observer::from_group_info instead of reported (supersede .4.57; per #110 such a LeafNode is invalid).
K5 (rules 6+7): GroupContext validator: every app_data_dictionary entry other than 0x0001/0x0002 must be listed in the GroupContext app_components; applied at create, to each Commit's resulting GroupContext, at join (Welcome/GroupInfo), and in the hub's room creation check. Knock-on: hub rooms must list franking_agent 0x0021, participant_list 0x0022, roles_list 0x0025, base_room_policy 0x0027 (and any other component they hold) in GroupContext app_components, so by rule 3 every member's leaf must list them: mimid's leaf list must grow (decision needed) and test fixtures (hub_acceptance, follower_e2e, tests/common, observer_app_data_update, mls-rs MLS_RS_APP_COMPONENTS) must be updated. content_media_types is covered by the same rule.
Decisions to record: K1 supersedes .4.25/.4.63; K4 supersedes .4.49 (for proposal/UpdatePath leaves) and .4.57; K5 leaf component set; a decision bead noting the deviation from published -10 §4.6/§5 (Mark chose editor's copy)."}
